config_binding_limits: Native Config reads the explicitly named JSON file and environment; environment values can override JSON values. A missing config path falls back to defaults.
These uppercase settings belong in configuration, not arbitrary SDK **kwargs. Extra kwargs are carried into LLM calls.
Model/route/effort/header and native retry bindings remain root-owned. No installed or active profile was inspected.
The intended requested model remains cx/gpt-6.1-sol-ultra for every relevant fast/smart/strategic LLM stage; this receipt does not establish an SDK request or delivered wire shape.

source_url_contract.nonempty_false_complement: Normal conductor chooses supplied URLs first and does not enter its ordinary web-search branch. It does not fall back to web search when this scrape yields empty research data.
source_url_contract.nonempty_true_complement: Additional native web search runs after supplied-source scraping.
source_url_contract.empty_or_null_urls: The supplied-source branch is false; ordinary report-source processing can perform web search or local/document processing.
source_url_contract.not_an_allowlist: The list fixes initial scrape inputs, not every HTTP destination or request. Redirects, native retries and scraper-specific re-fetches remain possible.

workflow_and_context_boundary.deep_workflow: research_report does not instantiate or select the deep report workflow. This is GPTR SDK orchestration, not native Codex Ultra orchestration.
workflow_and_context_boundary.mcp: Explicit mcp_strategy=disabled is accepted and takes precedence; mcp_configs=[] does not append MCP configurations. The candidate retriever configuration contains no MCP retriever.
workflow_and_context_boundary.embedding: CONTEXT_FILTER=none formats supplied-page context directly; the embedding factory is lazy and is not called by that branch. No shared GPU or embedding API is selected.
workflow_and_context_boundary.images: IMAGE_GENERATION_ENABLED=false avoids the optional generated-image workflow. Extracted image URL metadata is distinct from fetching or generating images.
workflow_and_context_boundary.inherited_state: Constructor defaults create a fresh visited set/context when omitted. Explicit existing context, visited URLs, documents/vector stores, logging handlers, configuration or process environment can change the boundary.
workflow_and_context_boundary.file_reads: The SDK imports code and reads its supplied JSON configuration/environment. Local/hybrid document-loader branches are bypassed by the selected nonempty-URL path; this is not a global filesystem-isolation claim.

get_costs_and_step_costs.limit: These are not authoritative native/provider token usage, cache, failed-attempt, retry or complete gateway ledger counters.

fetch_and_authentication_limits.gptr_scraper: Scraper constructs requests.Session and sets a User-Agent; BeautifulSoup uses session.get(link, timeout=10) with up to two attempts. Native scraper selection can override bs for PDF/arXiv inputs and can re-fetch detected PDF content.

requests_dependency.observation_scope: Static installed package source and exact public upstream source, not any auth/config store or live fetch.

fetch_and_authentication_limits.requests_behavior: Session.get enables redirects; Session.trust_env defaults true. Initial requests and redirected requests can use netrc lookup; proxy/environment behavior is inherited.
fetch_and_authentication_limits.native_netrc_override: Requests supports NETRC as an explicit lookup-path selector. When set it selects that path rather than home fallback. Binding to an owned nonsecret path remains a proposed caller control, not an executed qualification.
fetch_and_authentication_limits.hard_fetch_scope_status: No hard destination allowlist has been demonstrated for this SDK route. Selected text URLs avoid known PDF/arXiv selectors by construction, but redirects/DNS/destination/retry behavior remain unobserved.
